title: Arasan Detergent Cake
body_html: Arasan Detergent Cake is a household staple across Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka. It removes tough stains and dirt with a strong cleaning action and leaves clothes clean with a fresh fragrance.

title: Arasan Detergent Powder
body_html: Arasan Detergent Powder lifts dirt and grime from deep in the fabric and leaves a pleasant scent that lasts all day. Made for everyday hand and bucket wash.

title: Arasan Detergent Liquid 2 in 1
body_html: Arasan 2 in 1 Detergent Liquid with added fabric conditioner, made for top and front load washing machines. It gets deep into the fibres to remove stubborn stains and leaves clothes soft and fresh.

title: Arasan Limax Dish Wash Round
body_html: Limax Dish Wash Round by Arasan is an anti-bacterial dishwash tub, a monthly budget pack. Tough on grease and food residue yet gentle on hands, it leaves dishes clean and hygienic.
